text:
Steven Stamkos scored the overtime winner in Colorado on Thursday, a goal Yahoo Sports called a historic milestone. At 36, with 624 career goals coming into the season, two Rocket Richard Trophies and two Cups from Tampa, he's still what he always was: a shooter the puck finds.

Nine goals in 16 games, 11 power-play points, and the fourth-most wins added by goals of any skater in the league. Some of this will cool. He's shooting 23% on 6.25 expected goals, and Nashville has scored 4.7 more goals than expected with him on the ice. Those are two of the clearest regression signs we look for, and he's showing both.

The 5v5 play is the real concern: the Predators get under 44% of the expected goals with him out there. But last season he was the reverse case, with Evolving-Hockey valuing his chances at 2.6 wins against 1.6 actual. Call this year some of the payback. Our range has him around 38 goals. Watch his minutes: they're down more than a minute a night lately.
headline: Stamkos at 36: still the finisher, now the closer
